about.en: TURTLE is the token of Turtle, a distribution layer that routes liquidity providers into DeFi protocols and shares the incentives those protocols pay for deposits. It is an ERC-20 deployed at 0x66fd8de541c0594b4dccdfc13bf3a390e50d3afd on both Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain, and at 0x56aa6d651bfefa9207b35e508716466359bae8ef on Linea.
